def diheds(P,sq):
    res=[]; cur=list(P)
    for name in ['id','f','ft','v','h']:
        Q=P if name=='id' else P
        if name=='f': Q=[(i,sq-1-j,v) for i,j,v in P]
        elif name=='ft': Q=[(j,i,v) for i,j,v in P]
        elif name=='v': Q=[(sq-1-i,j,v) for i,j,v in P]
        elif name=='h': Q=[(i,sq-1-j,v) for i,j,v in P]

def transforms(P):
    # P: list of (i,j,v) normalized to bbox, h=max(i)+1 etc.
    pts=P
    h=max(i for i,j,_ in pts)+1; w=max(j for i,j,_ in pts)+1
    res=[]
    cur=[p[:] for p in pts]
    for k in range(4):
        res.append(('r%d'%k,tuple(sorted(cur))))
        res.append(('m%d'%k,tuple(sorted([(i,w-1-j,v) for i,j,v in cur]))))
        cur=[(j,h-1-i,v) for i,j,v in cur]  # rotate 90 ccw about origin then renormalize later
    return res

def info(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    sep=None
    for c in cnt:
        if any(all(v==c for v in g[i]) for i in range(H)):
            if any(all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(H)) for j in range(W)):
                sep=c; break
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if all(v==sep for v in g[i])]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(H))]
    Rb=bands(sr,H); Cb=bands(sc,W)
    T={}
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(Rb):
        for ci,(c,d) in enumerate(Cb):
            P=[(i-a,j-c,g[i][j]) for i in range(a,b+1) for j in range(c,d+1) if g[i][j]!=sep]
            if P:
                rs=[p[0] for p in P]; cs=[p[1] for p in P]
                P=tuple(sorted((i-min(rs),j-min(cs),v) for i,j,v in P))
            T[(ri,ci)]=P
    return T,Rb,Cb,sep

    def norm(q):
        mn=min(i for i,j,_ in q); mnj=min(j for i,j,_ in q)
        return tuple(sorted((i-mn,j-mnj,v) for i,j,v in q))
    cur=list(P); res=[]
    for _ in range(4):
        res.append(norm(cur)); res.append(norm([(i,len(cur)-1-j,v) for i,j,v in cur]))
        cur=[(j,len(cur)-1-i,v) for i,j,v in cur]
    return res

def dihed(P):
    def norm(q):
        mn=min(i for i,j,_ in q); mnj=min(j for i,j,_ in q)
        return tuple(sorted((i-mn,j-mnj,v) for i,j,v in q))
    cur=list(P); res=[]
    for _ in range(2):
        res.append(norm(cur)); res.append(norm([(i,len(cur)-1-j,v) for i,j,v in cur]))
        cur=[(j,len(cur)-1-i,v) for i,j,v in cur]
    return res

def bands(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    sep=max((v for v in sum(inp,[]) if v!=0),key=lambda v:sum(1 for r in inp for x in r if x==v))
    Rsep=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==sep for x in inp[r])]
    Csep=[c for c in range(W) if all(inp[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    tb=[(0,Rsep[0])]+[(Rsep[i],Rsep[i+1]) for i in range(len(Rsep)-1)]+[(Rsep[-1],H)]
    cb=[(0,Csep[0])]+[(Csep[i],Csep[i+1]) for i in range(len(Csep)-1)]+[(Csep[-1],W)]
    Ti=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(tb):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cb):
            cells={v:[(i-r0,j-c0) for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1) if inp[i][j]==v] for v in sum(inp,[]) if v not in (0,sep)}
            if cells: Ti.append(((ri,ci),cells))
    return tb,cb,Ti,sep

def variants(pts):
    res=[]; cur=list(pts)
    for _ in range(2):          # two mirrors
        for _ in range(4):      # four rotations
            n=(min(a for a,_ in cur),min(b for _,b in cur))
            rel=tuple(sorted((a-n[0],b-n[1]) for a,b in cur))
            res.append(rel); cur=[(b,-a) for a,b in cur]
        cur=[(a,-b) for a,b in cur]
    return res
